description: This is a build configuration Makefile for the glibc package in an OpenWrt build system. It defines variables, build steps, and configuration options for compiling glibc from source.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets toolchain information in info.mk using sed commands.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Creates build directory and runs the glibc configure script.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build environment and creates a symbolic link for source directory.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Removes build directories and related files.
